We had booked the complete hotel for wedding of my brother. The experience was really great. The Manager Rajesh was always there to fulfil our needs  according to our requirements. We held cocktail in the hotels banquet and Haldi ceremony on the Terrace. Thank you ♥️

SaltzStay Hotel offers a comfortable and pleasant stay with clean rooms, friendly staff, and a convenient location. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, making it a great choice for both short and extended visits. Overall, a reliable and enjoyable place to stay.
negative_snippets: Decent Stay for a day or two max. Rooms were not very clean. No rooms have balconies. But that’s due to the location constraint, I guess. Hotel location is at a good place. So accessibility isn’t an issue

Terrible Experience – Not Worth Staying

I stayed at Hotel Saltstayz, Paschim Vihar for just one night, and it was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had. At check-in, the reception staff said my luggage would be sent to the room, but it never arrived. After several calls and waiting, I finally had to go down and carry it myself.

The room was shabby and not properly maintained. Room service was completely unresponsive — despite repeated calls, no one ever showed up. The towels provided were dirty, and overall hygiene was very poor.

Due to such bad service and conditions, I checked out after just one night instead of staying longer.
Would not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable or professional stay.
